name: Honda CRF300L
intro: Honda's light dual-sport. Simple and tough, with a fuel system emissions recall worth checking.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and ask a Honda dealer about the emissions recall on 2021-2025 CRF300Ls for the fuel system. Some 2021 bikes were also in reflector recall 21V382.
A-002.reason: Recall work is free. The emissions recall doesn't apply to the Rally model.

E: Trail use wears wheel, steering and swingarm bearings fast. Check them all for play.

recalls.what: Fuel system failed a fuel permeation test.
recalls.fix: Free dealer repair. Not on Rally models.

recalls.what: Rear reflector may be too dim.
